svg.aria-label: Stack, only what is in the repos. Front end: TypeScript, React 19, Next.js 16, Tailwind CSS 4, Zustand, Motion, three.js. Back end: Node.js, PostgreSQL, Redis, Firebase, Cloudflare Workers + D1, Server-Sent Events. Shipping: GitHub Actions, Vitest, node:test, ESLint, Wrangler, PWA + service workers. Systems: Rust, C++, Direct2D, SteamVR driver, Python for tooling. Ops: A Linux server I run myself, Ubuntu 24.04.
